situation: Last weekend, you celebrated a special family occasion at a restaurant. One of the staff members gave you excellent service and made the evening very special.
task: Write an email to the restaurant manager in about 150-200 words. You are praising the staff member.
points: Describe the occasion you were celebrating.
Explain what the staff member did to help.
Suggest how the restaurant could reward this employee.
sample:
Dear Manager,

I am writing to tell you about the wonderful service my family received at your restaurant last Saturday evening.

We came to celebrate my parents' fortieth wedding anniversary. There were twelve of us, including my grandmother, who uses a wheelchair, and three young children. I was a little worried about bringing such a large group.

Our server, Priya, made everything easy. Before we arrived, she had moved our table closer to the entrance so that my grandmother could reach it comfortably. She was patient with the children, brought their meals first and remembered that my nephew has a nut allergy. At the end of the evening, she surprised my parents with a small cake and a candle, and she even offered to take a family photo for us. My mother was moved to tears.

I believe an employee like Priya should be recognized. Perhaps you could name her employee of the month or give her a bonus. At the very least, I hope you will share this email with her.

We will certainly come back soon.

Kind regards,

Julia Novak
